title: Local vanishing on affine opens for restricted lower tails
statement: Under the hypotheses of the local bound, for every affine open U of V, every p>0 and q<0, the displayed open module cohomology object of the q-th homology of the restricted lower truncation is zero.

proof.text: Use Functor.mapDerivedCategoryHomologyFunctorIso for exact schemeOpenRestriction to move homology before restriction. Split on q < a.

Below a, the truncation inclusion induces an isomorphism on degree-q homology; homologyFunctorFactors identifies the untruncated object with F.homology q. At or above a, truncLT a is IsLE (a - 1), so its degree-q homology is zero and the additive restriction and cohomology functors preserve that zero object.

Let W be the image of U under V.ι. It is affine and contained in V. Choose an injective resolution of F.homology q using enough injectives. Its transported open restriction remains an injective resolution by restrict_injectiveResolution and the equivalence overEquiv V. overFunctorEquiv V and restrictAppIso identify sections on U of each restricted term with sections on W of the original term. Applying homology and isoRightDerivedObj gives an isomorphism of the two open cohomology objects.

Apply nonempty_openModuleCohomology_addEquiv_restrict_H on X and W. Write p = r + 1 using p > 0; the supplied hhomology makes this abelian cohomology subsingleton. Transport subsingletonness and then IsZero back along the comparison isomorphisms.

theorem affineBasisRestrictedLowerTail_local_vanishing
    (X : Scheme.{u}) (V : X.Opens) (hV : IsAffineOpen V)
    [HasDerivedCategory.{wC} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace))]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{wV} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings V.toScheme.toRingedSpace))]
    (F : CochainComplex X.Modules ℤ)
    (hhomology : ∀ (W : X.Opens), IsAffineOpen W → W ≤ V → ∀ (n : ℤ) (q : ℕ),
      Subsingleton (((F.homology n).restrict W.ι).H (q + 1)))
    (a : ℤ) (U : Opens V.toScheme) (hU : IsAffineOpen U) (p : ℕ) (hp : 0 < p)
    (q : ℤ) (hq : q < 0) :
    IsZero ((RingedSpace.openModuleCohomology V.toScheme.toRingedSpace p U).obj
      ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor
        (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings V.toScheme.toRingedSpace)) q).obj
        ((schemeOpenRestriction X V).mapDerivedCategory.obj
          (((DerivedCategory.TStructure.t
            (C := SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace))).truncLT a).obj
            (DerivedCategory.Q.obj F)))))
